title: 36 Hours in Fez, Morocco
abstract: In this delightful patchwork metropolis, a gust of creative modernity, with new hotels, shops and cafes complementing the city’s ancient allure.

title: 36 Hours in Sapporo, Japan
abstract: The capital of Hokkaido has more to offer than snow: urban parks and a spate of new galleries, shops and restaurants make this a city for all seasons.

title: 36 Hours in St. Pete Beach, Fla. (and Environs)
abstract: Along a seam of white sugar-sand beaches, a string of Florida beach towns offers a version of vacation bliss, replete with seafood and midcentury ambience.

title: 36 Hours in San Antonio
abstract: Known for its 15-mile River Walk, the city offers a version of Texas that mixes traditional with innovative.

title: 36 Hours in Victoria Falls (Zimbabwe Side)
abstract: With adrenaline-pumping activities galore, there are countless ways to experience this enthralling natural wonder.
